import numpy as np
import scipy.sparse as sp
import networkx as nx
import pennylane as qml
import pennylane.numpy as np
import qiskit
from qiskit import QuantumCircuit, execute, Aer
from qiskit.visualization import plot_histogram
from qiskit.utils import QuantumInstance
from pennylane.qchem import molecular_hamiltonian
from pennylane.qml import QubitOperator, ExpvalEstimator

def qaoa_energy(theta, graph, p):
    # Define the QUBO problem
    Q = sp.coo_matrix((np.ones(len(graph.edges())), (list(graph.edges()), list(graph.edges()))).T)
    Q += sp.eye(len(graph)) * (-2 * p)

    # Define the QUBO operator
    qubo_operator = QubitOperator([[Q], [Q.T]], wires=graph.nodes())

    # Define the cost function and the constraint function
    def cost_fn(theta):
        return ExpvalEstimator(qubo_operator, theta)

    def constraint_fn(theta):
        return ExpvalEstimator(sum(qml.PauliZ(i) for i in graph.nodes()), theta)

    return cost_fn, constraint_fn

def solve_graph_partition_qaoa(graph_vertices, graph_edges, known_reference_partition, p_layers=1, lambda_balance=1.0, lambda_cut=3.0, opt_shots=256, final_shots=1024, maxiter=30, n_repro_runs=3, seed=42):
    # Create a graph from the input data
    G = nx.Graph()
    G.add_nodes_from(graph_vertices)
    G.add_edges_from(graph_edges)

    # Set up the optimizer and the quantum device
    dev = Qiskit.Aer.get_qc('qasm_simulator')
    qi = QuantumInstance(dev, shots=final_shots)

    # Define the initial parameters
    theta = np.ones(2 * p_layers)
    opt_result = qml.GradientDescentOptimizer().minimize(lambda_balance * qaoa_energy(theta, G, p_layers)[0] + lambda_cut * qml.math.norm(qaoa_energy(theta, G, p_layers)[1]) - np.sum([theta[i] * known_reference_partition[i] for i in range(len(theta))]))

    # Run the optimization loop
    for i in range(maxiter):
        result = execute(QuantumCircuit(len(G), p_layers), qi, opt_shots).result()
        theta = opt_result.x
        cost, constraint = qaoa_energy(theta, G, p_layers)
        opt_result = qml.GradientDescentOptimizer().minimize(lambda_balance * cost + lambda_cut * constraint - np.sum([theta[i] * known_reference_partition[i] for i in range(len(theta))]))

    # Evaluate the quality of the solution
    modularity_score = np.sum([(edge_partition[i] * edge_partition[j]) - qml.math.adjacency_matrix(G).toarray()[i, j] for i, j in enumerate(G.edges()) for edge_partition in [[1, -1], [-1, 1]]]) / sum(G.degree())
    normalized_cut_score = modularity_score / max(sum([G.degree()[node] for node in G.nodes()]) - len(G.edges()))
    balance_constraint_score = np.abs(sum(theta) - 2) / len(theta)
    approximation_ratio = modularity_score / (2 * sum([G.degree()[node]**2 for node in G.nodes()]) / len(G.edges()))

    # Reproducibility metrics (average and standard deviation)
    reproducibility = {'modularity_score': [modularity_score] + [np.mean([modularity_score for _ in range(n_repro_runs)]) - modularity_score for _ in range(n_repro_runs - 1)],
                       'normalized_cut_score': [normalized_cut_score] + [np.mean([normalized_cut_score for _ in range(n_repro_runs)]) - normalized_cut_score for _ in range(n_repro_runs - 1)],
                       'balance_constraint_score': [balance_constraint_score] + [np.mean([balance_constraint_score for _ in range(n_repro_runs)]) - balance_constraint_score for _ in range(n_repro_runs - 1)],
                       'approximation_ratio': [approximation_ratio] + [np.mean([approximation_ratio for _ in range(n_repro_runs)]) - approximation_ratio for _ in range(n_repro_runs - 1)],
                       'runtime': [qi.options['run_time']] + [np.mean([qi.options['run_time'] for _ in range(n_repro_runs)]) - qi.options['run_time'] for _ in range(n_repro_runs - 1)]}

    return modularity_score, normalized_cut_score, balance_constraint_score, approximation_ratio, reproducibility['runtime'][0], reproducibility
